advancements.tpsthings.layer.oo.descript:
Every layer descended
and the word that came out was only that
advancements.tpsthings.layer.root.descri:
From the surface of hope
to the floor of the world's index
advancements.tpsthings.layer.root.title: Penetration Layers
advancements.tpsthings.layer.title: %s %s
item.tpsthings.anti_hope_sheet.poem:
Turn hope inside out
and what is left is not despair
but nothing happening at all
item.tpsthings.cancelled_event.poem:
The voice that was called
reached no one
cancelled
item.tpsthings.coremod.poem:
Before the class is born
rewrite its name
with no one noticing
item.tpsthings.death_hook.poem:
The closing procedure
crushed halfway through
death is not here yet
item.tpsthings.erased_index.poem:
Struck from the world's register
the name is gone
and it is still breathing
item.tpsthings.frozen_tick.poem:
Ten ticks after the blow
the world waits for you
a very small mercy
item.tpsthings.invulnerable_flag.poem:
One boolean
and the blade no longer reaches
a thin, thin flag
item.tpsthings.java_agent.poem:
It was there
before anything was loaded
from the very beginning
item.tpsthings.lying_reader.poem:
Every time you ask
it answers that you are full
a kind lie
item.tpsthings.mixin.poem:
Into someone else's body
you slip a quiet word
with one line at the head
item.tpsthings.raw_health.poem:
Stripped of its wrapping
the number called health
is frailer than you thought
item.tpsthings.removal_veto.poem:
Told to disappear
it shook its head
and that was all
item.tpsthings.undefined_behavior.poem:
In the margin of the spec
you may write anything
even demons out of your nose
jei.tpsthings.annihilation.info: Throw the ingredients together onto the top face of the annihilation chamber to make it react. The result is drawn at random, and a bad draw leaves nothing behind.
jei.tpsthings.ritual.info: Oo cannot be made at a crafting table. Throw the following onto the annihilation chamber one at a time, from the top of the list down. Start by placing a single anti-HOPE sheet on an otherwise empty top face. Mixing in an ingredient from a deeper layer fails the ritual and leaves "not quite oo" behind, and throwing nothing for a minute breaks it off.
tooltip.tpsthings.oo.murmur.2: That has to be an oo
